advisories.advisory_title: Kharif Soybean Sowing, Drainage & Water Management
advisories.title: Kharif Soybean Sowing, Drainage & Water Management
advisories.advisory_text: Ensure 75-100 mm rainfall accumulation before sowing. Use Broad Bed Furrow (BBF) or ridge and furrow method to facilitate moisture conservation and prevent waterlogging during intense rainfall events.
advisories.summary: Ensure 75-100 mm rainfall accumulation before sowing. Use Broad Bed Furrow (BBF) or ridge and furrow method to facilitate moisture conservation and prevent waterlogging during intense rainfall events.
advisories.precautions: Avoid deep sowing beyond 3-4 cm. Ensure seed treatment with Rhizobium and PSB bio-fertilizers. Do not apply chemical weedicides or pesticides without verifying local soil moisture.
advisories.field_action: Prepare BBF beds with 30-45 cm row spacing to allow excess runoff disposal.

advisories.source_name: Vasantrao Naik Marathwada Krishi Vidyapeeth (VNMKV), Parbhani
advisories.advisory_title: Integrated Monitoring for Girdle Beetle and Stem Fly
advisories.title: Integrated Monitoring for Girdle Beetle and Stem Fly
advisories.advisory_text: Regularly inspect 20 random plants per field for girdle beetle ring marks on petioles and stem fly tunneling. Hand-collect and destroy affected plant parts in early vegetative stages before infestation spreads.
advisories.summary: Regularly inspect 20 random plants per field for girdle beetle ring marks on petioles and stem fly tunneling. Hand-collect and destroy affected plant parts in early vegetative stages before infestation spreads.
advisories.precautions: Do not apply chemical sprays indiscriminately. Check Economic Threshold Levels (ETL) and consult local KVK agronomists before applying any chemical treatment.
advisories.field_action: Clip and safely bury infested branches showing typical ring girdling.

advisories.advisory_title: Intercropping and Soil Moisture Conservation Guidance
advisories.title: Intercropping and Soil Moisture Conservation Guidance
advisories.advisory_text: Adopt Soybean + Pigeonpea (Tur) intercropping at 4:2 or 3:1 ratio in medium to deep black soils. This improves risk resilience against dry spells and optimizes root nutrient utilization.
advisories.summary: Adopt Soybean + Pigeonpea (Tur) intercropping at 4:2 or 3:1 ratio in medium to deep black soils. This improves risk resilience against dry spells and optimizes root nutrient utilization.
advisories.precautions: Maintain adequate spacing between rows to avoid fungal foliar disease development in dense canopies.
advisories.field_action: Ensure clean field borders to reduce pest migration from surrounding weeds.

advisories.source_name: Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra (Krishi Vibhag)
advisories.advisory_title: Statewide Seed Germination Testing & Varietal Advice
advisories.title: Statewide Seed Germination Testing & Varietal Advice
advisories.advisory_text: Farmers are advised to conduct on-farm seed germination test (minimum 70% germination threshold) before sowing. Use certified seeds of recommended varieties: JS 335, JS 93-05, MAUS 71, MAUS 158.
advisories.summary: Farmers are advised to conduct on-farm seed germination test (minimum 70% germination threshold) before sowing. Use certified seeds of recommended varieties: JS 335, JS 93-05, MAUS 71, MAUS 158.
advisories.precautions: Never purchase loose uncertified seeds without valid bill and batch tags.
advisories.field_action: Test 100 seeds wrapped in wet gunny bag for 5 days to confirm viability.

advisories.issuing_authority: ICAR - Central Institute for Cotton Research (CICR)
advisories.advisory_title: Pink Bollworm (PBW) Integrated Monitoring & Threshold Surveillance
advisories.title: Pink Bollworm (PBW) Integrated Monitoring & Threshold Surveillance
advisories.advisory_text: Install pheromone traps @ 5 traps per hectare for Pink Bollworm (PBW) moth surveillance starting at 45 DAS. Inspect 20 green bolls per acre for rosette flowers or young larvae entrance holes.
advisories.summary: Install pheromone traps @ 5 traps per hectare for Pink Bollworm (PBW) moth surveillance starting at 45 DAS. Inspect 20 green bolls per acre for rosette flowers or young larvae entrance holes.
advisories.precautions: Avoid synthetic pyrethroid sprays early in the season to prevent resurgence of sucking pests (whiteflies, aphids) and preserve natural predators like chrysopids.
advisories.field_action: Replace pheromone lures every 21 days to maintain surveillance accuracy.

advisories.source_name: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth (PDKV), Akola
advisories.advisory_title: Surface Drainage & Sucking Pest Management in Heavy Black Soils
advisories.title: Surface Drainage & Sucking Pest Management in Heavy Black Soils
advisories.advisory_text: Cotton is extremely sensitive to waterlogging. Provide surface drainage channels between rows (every 3 to 6 rows) to drain excess stagnant water during heavy spells. For sucking pests, monitor leaf yellowing curl margins.
advisories.summary: Cotton is extremely sensitive to waterlogging. Provide surface drainage channels between rows (every 3 to 6 rows) to drain excess stagnant water during heavy spells. For sucking pests, monitor leaf yellowing curl margins.
advisories.precautions: Continuous waterlogging causes square and flower drop. Clean drainage furrows immediately before forecast monsoon rain.
advisories.field_action: Open conservation furrows in every 3rd or 6th row with a tractor-drawn ridger or country plough.

advisories.source_name: Vasantrao Naik Marathwada Krishi Vidyapeeth (VNMKV), Parbhani
advisories.advisory_title: Canopy Management and Foliar Nutrition Guidance
advisories.title: Canopy Management and Foliar Nutrition Guidance
advisories.advisory_text: Monitor excessive vegetative growth in high-density planting. In rainfed conditions experiencing prolonged dry spells, foliar spray of 1% potassium nitrate (13:0:45) helps reduce square dropping.
advisories.summary: Monitor excessive vegetative growth in high-density planting. In rainfed conditions experiencing prolonged dry spells, foliar spray of 1% potassium nitrate (13:0:45) helps reduce square dropping.
advisories.precautions: Avoid spraying during peak midday sunshine; prefer late afternoon sprays when leaves are turgid.
advisories.field_action: Remove monopodial excess vegetative branches in high-density cotton to enhance aeration.

verification_principles: A reachable URL is NOT proof that an advisory is current or applicable.
Never treat historical advisories (past months or past years) as current advice.
Check crop, growth stage, soil type, and agro-climatic zone before applying any guidance.
Never fabricate sources, authors, publication dates, or chemical doses.
If current guidance is unavailable or unverified, state that uncertainty clearly.
